title: Third 256^2 seed and a per-individual E test for the digestion-driven predator ecology: seed 2 repeats the claim (predator persistent splits 37, generation 3; prey 51, generation 4; frozen twin with 0 prey splits), and cutting the prey supply of one predator-prey pair in a disk dissolves that predator within ~600 t while its fed twin and the neighbouring predators persist (seeds 0 and 1)
summary: Same world as 20261027T0325-c52-digestion-ecology-claim. pack256/seed2 (labkit, 256^2, t=12000, default K=20): 178 predators and 182 prey at the end, 80 persistent predator tracks, 37 predator persistent splits (generation 3, merge/split 0.44), 51 prey persistent splits (generation 4, merge/split 0.51), 300 and 317 moving tracks; pred_ancestry.png follows predator track 147 from nucleation at t=2400 through splits at t=3300, 4600 and 6000 to t=12000. twin256/seed2 (pred_on 0): 147 static prey, 0 persistent splits, 1 moving track. Local cut (world_local.py, localcut.py, 128^2): from t=6000 all prey material inside a disk of radius 12 around one predator-prey pair is removed every step; the predator material in the disk plus a 6 px margin falls from max c_b 1.38 and 1.30 to 0.54 and 0.36 by t=6600 and to the bath (0.05-0.06) by t=8000, with no predator body left in the area, while in the uncut twin the same area keeps max c_b 1.28-1.55 and 1-4 predator bodies; predator bodies elsewhere 50 -> 43 (cut) vs 50 -> 45 (fed) on seed 0 and 43 -> 42 vs 43 -> 42 on seed 1.

finding.operator: digestion-driven condensation of a conserved predator material
finding.control: local ablation of one pair's prey supply with an uncut twin (seeds 0 and 1); third 256^2 seed with matched predator-free twin
finding.result: cut area max c_b 1.38/1.30 -> 0.05/0.06 (twin 1.43/1.43 at t=8000); seed 2: 37 predator and 51 prey persistent splits vs twin 0

limits: The cut removes prey material inside the disk every step, so it is a local sink of prey material, not only of food access; the predator could in principle leave the disk to find prey (it does not within 2000 t). One pair per seed. strict_pred_a10.png (splits3.py, min area 10): 37 predator divisions, all with prey within 6 px (joint pair fission, as in the claim).
